quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the contrast between others' progress and the speaker's sense of standing still.
quests.explanation: Feeling you have nothing new to offer at a reunion compared to others reflects quiet sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone at the reunion had so much to say. I realized I'd had nothing new to share in years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Finally have our proof' after five years of work — what emotion marks the validation of a long effort?
quests.explanation: Five years of research confirmed in a single result is a moment of profound professional excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The research results just came back — exactly what we predicted. After five years, we finally have our proof.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-empty house showing signs of occupancy — what emotion does an unexplained light produce?
quests.explanation: An unexplained light in a long-empty house creates a sense of mystery and curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: That old house has been empty since I moved to this street. Someone was upstairs last night — I saw the light.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Significant unseen effort and then being overlooked for a promotion — what emotion results?
quests.explanation: Being passed over for promotion despite visible, sustained extra effort produces anger and resentment.
quests.textToSpeak: I stayed late every night this month and nobody even mentioned it when the promotion was announced.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching a fourth version of the same content in one week — what emotion has replaced interest?
quests.explanation: Encountering the same content for the fourth time with no new information is a cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: This documentary covers the same material as the three others I watched on the same topic this week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unexpected welcome by your entire family after two years apart — what is the emotional impact?
quests.explanation: Being met by your whole family after a two-year absence produces strong, overwhelming happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I got off the train and my whole family was standing on the platform. I hadn't seen them in two years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Self-reassurance that keeps failing — what emotion is the speaker struggling to control?
quests.explanation: Failed self-reassurance before a feared first experience is a clear sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've never flown before and we board in an hour. I keep telling myself it's perfectly safe — it's not working.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Finding out about a major change to a personal landmark completely by accident — what is this?
quests.explanation: Discovering a major change to a meaningful place with no prior notice produces surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The building I worked in for fifteen years was converted into apartments. I didn't hear about it until today.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Experience across all conditions leading to a simple expectation of success — what emotion is this?
quests.explanation: Claiming certainty of finishing based on repeated prior experience is a direct expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've run this exact route in every kind of weather. I'll finish today's race just like all the others.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An empty peg at a school where a child's things are usually kept — what does 'empty' suggest here?
quests.explanation: A child's empty space at school, likely because they are no longer there, evokes quiet sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The school asked parents to collect their child's art from the year. I walked past her empty peg.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The gap between two opposing accounts of the same event — what does the speaker feel toward this gap?
quests.explanation: Noticing a consistent contradiction between opposing accounts expresses intellectual curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: There's a completely different story on the other side of every news article I read this week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Exceeding targets with time to spare — what professional emotion does outstanding performance produce?
quests.explanation: Hitting targets ahead of schedule and recognizing outstanding results produces professional excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: I hit my target early this quarter and we've still got two months to go. These numbers are outstanding.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A 240-page mandatory document due by Friday — what emotion does that volume and deadline produce?
quests.explanation: Being required to read an enormous document in a short time for routine compliance suggests boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The new employee handbook is two hundred and forty pages long and we're required to read all of it by Friday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being blamed for someone else's mistake after clear information was provided — what emotion is this?
quests.explanation: Being asked to prove someone else's own clear error is a cause of strong indignation and anger.
quests.textToSpeak: You had my ticket details. You processed the refund to the wrong account and now you want me to prove it was your error?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unsolicited act of kindness that perfectly describes someone's character — what feeling does this produce?
quests.explanation: Receiving an unsolicited, caring act of kindness and recognizing the person's character produces happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: She knocked on my door with soup when I was sick for a week. That's the kind of person she is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unexpected act of generosity that nobody would have predicted — what is the natural reaction?
quests.explanation: Leaving a valuable building freely to the community is an unexpected act that produces genuine surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The man who ran the local shop for thirty years retired and left the building to the neighborhood free of charge.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A high-level audience and a physical symptom appearing ten minutes before — what emotion is this?
quests.explanation: A cracking voice before a high-stakes presentation to senior leaders is a physical sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: The panel includes the CEO and three board members. My presentation is in ten minutes and my voice is already cracking.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two non-functional contact methods and an unanswered question — what does the speaker feel?
quests.explanation: Being unable to reach an organization through any channel and asking 'who runs this?' expresses curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The email address on the form is inactive. The phone number goes to voicemail. Who runs this organization?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A positive achievement made bittersweet by someone who cannot be there to witness it — what is this feeling?
quests.explanation: Joy at an achievement shadowed by the absence of someone who believed in you creates a bittersweet sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: She passed her driving test on the first try. I wish Dad could have been there — he always said she could do it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Know exactly what I want' after thorough preparation — what state of mind does this reflect?
quests.explanation: Thorough preparation combined with absolute clarity about your goal reflects strong confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read every negotiating book in the library. When I walk into that room, I know exactly what I want.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A community resource destroyed without consultation for an unused replacement — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: Removing something valued without community input for a purpose that isn't being used produces anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They removed the community garden to build a car park that isn't even in use yet. Nobody was consulted.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Four years of effort finally producing the outcome you have worked and waited for — what emotion is this?
quests.explanation: Four years of trying to adopt finally being rewarded with a match is a source of profound happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We've been trying to adopt for four years. The agency called this morning — there's a little girl who needs a home.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Nobody asked for' these speeches in a three-hour event — what emotion does the speaker feel?
quests.explanation: A three-hour ceremony full of unwanted speeches is a cause of tedium and boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: Another awards ceremony with a three-hour running time and speeches nobody asked for.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An outcome that directly contradicts early performance — what does such a reversal produce?
quests.explanation: A dramatic reversal from the bottom to the top of the class over four years is genuinely surprising.
quests.textToSpeak: The student who barely passed the entrance exam graduated at the top of the class four years later.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A recurring, unexplained act with no known source — what emotion does the mystery produce?
quests.explanation: A monthly unexplained gesture at a memorial with no known explanation creates ongoing curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Every month, someone leaves a single white flower on the memorial bench. Nobody knows who or why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A cherished tradition tied to a specific place, which now belongs to strangers — what is this feeling?
quests.explanation: Losing the setting of a cherished annual tradition to new owners produces sadness and a sense of loss.
quests.textToSpeak: We used to spend every Christmas at that house. This year it belongs to someone else.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Twelve years of waiting for professional artistic recognition finally arriving — what emotion comes with it?
quests.explanation: Gaining the first professional gallery showing after twelve years of work produces intense excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The gallery finally agreed to show my work. I've been painting for twelve years waiting for this chance.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Postponing a difficult conversation all week — what emotion drives the avoidance?
quests.explanation: Delaying a conversation you know will not be well received is driven by anxiety and nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I need to tell my parents something tonight that they're not going to take well. I've been putting it off all week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Damaged delivery followed by blame-shifting rather than accountability — what emotion results?
quests.explanation: Being delivered damaged goods and then accused of causing the damage produces clear anger.
quests.textToSpeak: There's no excuse for delivering damaged goods and then arguing about whether the damage was already there.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Three times before, won every time' — what level of professional certainty does this reflect?
quests.explanation: A perfect track record in identical situations and clear prediction of the outcome shows confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've represented this kind of case three times before and won every time. I know where this is going.
